description:
About LogicGate 
LogicGate is the leading AI GRC platform for the Enterprise, helping governance, risk, and compliance teams limit surprises, strengthen resilience, augment program performance, and confidently quantify impact and business value. Built to provide a centralized view of risk and complia nce, with AI intelligence woven into the platform's core, LogicGate delivers real-time insights and actionable data to help drive current business decisions, with the flexibility to scale alongside evolving business needs. Recognized as a Leader in the GRC Market, LogicGate continues to further solidify its position as a best-in-class platform. 

 The GRC Market
 Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) is a rapidly expanding sector, with a global market size projected to reach $104.5 billion by 2031. LogicGate is at the forefront of this industry transformation, empowering enterprise professionals to navigate complex regulatory environments, manage critical uncertainty, and operate with integrity at scale. 

 

 
  

 Software Engineer: Front-End 

 Location: Hybrid | Chicago, IL

 At LogicGate, we recognize that exceptional talent comes in all shapes and forms, and that there is no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. The qualifications below represent the core competencies, skills, and experiences that align most closely with the day-to-day responsibilities of this role - if you don't check every single box and are excited about this work, we still highly encourage you to apply.

 About the Role 

 As a Front-End Software Engineer at LogicGate, you will build responsive, high-performing user experiences across Risk Cloud®, our market-leading AI GRC platform. Risk and compliance teams depend on our platform daily to turn complex data into actionable, automated workflows, making intuitive and resilient architecture essential to our product. Working in an agile squad alongside Product Managers, Designers, QA, and Back-end engineers, you will co-design API contracts, ship modular Angular components, and trace features end-to-end to ensure production reliability. This role is ideal for an engineer who wants to understand the full request lifecycle—from a click in the browser down through the service layer—and translate complex business challenges into seamless enterprise user experiences.



 What You’ll Do 

 
 End-to-End Feature Delivery: Design, build, and ship scalable features using TypeScript and Angular on the front end and interfacing with Java, Kotlin, and Spring Boot on the back end.

 API & Contract Design: Build and evolve REST APIs with consuming front-end interfaces in mind, maintaining stable, versioned, and clearly documented contracts for cross-squad integration.

 Production Ownership: Own the health of released features by investigating customer-reported issues alongside Support and QA, translating findings into actionable fixes and enhanced monitoring.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Design, QA, and fellow engineers during Agile sprints, working primarily from our Chicago HQ to foster in-person collaboration, rapid iteration, and team trust.

 Accountability & Execution: Operate in a self-directed manner to estimate effort, deliver on sprint commitments, and proactively communicate blockers or updates in Jira and shared team channels.

 Code Comprehension & SDLC Discipline: Shepherd merge requests through the code review process efficiently, maintaining high standards for linting, test coverage, and documentation to prevent team bottlenecks.

 Systematic Debugging: Trace issues from the browser component tree through the API and data layers, utilizing tools like Datadog to independently investigate and resolve routine problems before escalating.

 Quality & Automation: Write robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using JUnit, Jasmine, and Cypress, ensuring low defect escape across both sides of the stack.

 AI-Augmented Engineering: Leverage AI coding assistants (like Claude Code) securely to accelerate scaffolding, testing, and debugging, while rigorously verifying output and protecting proprietary data.

 
 What You Bring 

 Required: 

 
 Professional Experience: 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience building and maintaining modern, scalable web applications in a production B2B SaaS or enterprise environment.

 Front-End Proficiency: Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Angular (or modern component-based frameworks like React or Vue, paired with a demonstrated ability to ramp rapidly in an enterprise Angular codebase).

 API & Data Integration: Practical experience consuming RESTful APIs, mocking endpoints, and managing complex front-end application state aligned with relational backend data structures.

 Automated Testing & Security Discipline: Daily commitment to writing automated tests across unit and E2E layers (Cypress, Jasmine), paired with a foundational understanding of client-side web security (OWASP Top 10, role-based access control, input sanitization).

 AI Literacy & Productivity: Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience using modern AI tools (Claude Code, Copilot, ChatGPT) to enhance developer velocity, accompanied by sound judgment regarding hallucination risks and data privacy.

 Flexibility for On-Site Engagement: Located within commuting distance of LogicGate’s Chicago HQ with the willingness and ability to work on-site for regular squad collaboration, sprint ceremonies, and team gatherings.

 
 Nice to Have: 

 
 Full-Stack & JVM Exposure: Working familiarity with JVM backend languages (Java, Kotlin) and Spring Boot, or practical experience querying relational databases (PostgreSQL).

 Enterprise B2B SaaS & GRC: Prior experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms, configurable workflow engines, or data-dense low-code builders where strict data governance matters.

 Accessibility & Web Performance: Hands-on experience optimizing browser runtime performance and implementing WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards across complex interfaces.

 
 
 The anticipated base salary range for the role is $105,000 - $130,000 per year + variable + equity + benefits. Actual salaries may vary and will be based on factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Internal candidates who have current pay within or above the hiring range are still encouraged to apply if interested.


 How We Work 
 At LogicGate, we empower organizations to transform risk into a strategic advantage. As we continue to scale, we are looking for driven, high-performing individuals who are ready to take ownership, raise the bar, and do the best work of their careers.

 Our culture is built on execution, collaboration, and a shared commitment to excellence. We believe the strongest, most innovative teams are forged by diverse perspectives. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment where differences are celebrated and supported.

 Global Total Rewards 
We invest in our people with a comprehensive and competitive rewards package designed to support our team members across the US and the UK:

 
 Compensation & Equity: Competitive base salaries, variable compensation plans, and equity options.

 Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive health, wellness, and lifestyle benefits tailored to your region.

 Time Away: Generous paid time off and annual company holidays so you can recharge and return at your best.

 Growth & Development: Continuous career advancement through structured mentorship, leadership training, and premium learning platforms.

 
 Recognized as a top workplace by Built In, Crain’s Chicago Business, and the Chicago Tribune. 

 
 LogicGate is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a high-performing, diverse workforce. We make all employment decisions based on merit, business needs, and professional qualifications. We strictly prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic governed by federal, state, and local laws in the United States, the Equality Act 2010 in the United Kingdom, or applicable regulations in any jurisdiction where we operate.
